title: Strangle the legacy pages behind a facade

task.text: `Site` mixes the routing rules with both systems; migrating one more path means editing it.
Put a **strangler facade** in front. `new Site().handle(userId, path)` must return exactly what it returns now.

items: Add `interface Backend` with `String handle(String userId, String path)`; the old and new systems each implement it.
Add `StranglerFacade implements Backend` with `StranglerFacade(Backend legacy, Backend modern)` and a chainable `migrate(String prefix, int percent)`.
A path starting with a migrated prefix goes to `modern` when `Math.floorMod(userId.hashCode(), 100) < percent`, else `legacy`. The first matching rule wins; no rule means `legacy`.
`Site` just builds the facade with its two rules and delegates.

checks.title: /invoices is migrated for half the users
A user always sees the same system
The facade is a Backend over two Backends
The facade routes any backends by rule
Site no longer routes by itself

hints.text: Callers must not notice which system answers. Give the old system and the new one the same interface, and put the choosing in one place that is also that interface.
`StranglerFacade` keeps two `Backend` fields and an ordered `Map<String, Integer>` of prefix to percent. `migrate` adds a rule and returns `this`. `Site` builds one facade and forwards to it.
